name: Orrery
description: Thin orbits ring the middle of the sheet around a small sun, and planets of every size ride on them.

code.style: --rule: ( --a: @r(-0.4, 0.4); --ps: @p(10%, 13%, 16%, 21%, 27%); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% at @calc(50 + (0 - @dx) * 100)% @calc(50 + (0 - @dy) * 100)%, var(--color2) 0 10%, transparent 10%), repeating-radial-gradient(ellipse @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% @calc((min(@X, @Y) / 2) * 100)% at @calc(50 + (0 - @dx) * 100)% @calc(50 + (0 - @dy) * 100)%, var(--color1) 0 0.9%, transparent 0.9% 24%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: @var(--ps); height: @var(--ps); left: calc(50% + (@calc((max(round(sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2))), 1) * (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2)))) * cos(@calc(atan2(@dy, @dx) * 180 / PI)deg + @var(--a) * @calc((57.3 / (max(round(sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2))), 1) * (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2)))))deg) - @dx) * 100% - @var(--ps) / 2); top: calc(50% + (@calc((max(round(sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2))), 1) * (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2)))) * sin(@calc(atan2(@dy, @dx) * 180 / PI)deg + @var(--a) * @calc((57.3 / (max(round(sqrt(@dx * @dx + @dy * @dy) / (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2))), 1) * (0.24 * (min(@X, @Y) / 2)))))deg) - @dy) * 100% - @var(--ps) / 2); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
